options.name: bs
options.description: Set input and output block size

options.name: files
options.description: Copy this many files before terminating

options.name: if
options.description: Read an input file instead of stdin

options.name: iseek
options.description: Seek this many blocks on the input file

options.name: of
options.description: Write to an output file instead of stdout

options.name: oseek
options.description: Seek this many blocks on the output file

options.name: seek
options.description: Seek this many blocks from the beginning of the output before copying

options.name: skip
options.description: Skip this many blocks from the beginning of the input before copying

suggestions.name: ascii
suggestions.description: The same as 'unblock' except characters are translated from EBCDIC to ASCII

suggestions.name: oldascii
suggestions.description: The same as 'unblock' except characters are translated from EBCDIC to ASCII

suggestions.name: block
suggestions.description: Treats the input as a sequence of newline or EOF-terminated variable length records of independent input and output block boundaries

suggestions.name: ebcdic
suggestions.description: The same as the 'block' value except that characters are translated from ASCII to EBCDIC after the records are converted

suggestions.name: ibm
suggestions.description: The same as the 'block' value except that characters are translated from ASCII to EBCDIC after the records are converted

suggestions.name: oldebcdic
suggestions.description: The same as the 'block' value except that characters are translated from ASCII to EBCDIC after the records are converted

suggestions.name: oldibm
suggestions.description: The same as the 'block' value except that characters are translated from ASCII to EBCDIC after the records are converted

suggestions.name: lcase
suggestions.description: Transform uppercase characters into lowercase characters

suggestions.name: noerror
suggestions.description: Do not stop processing on an input error

suggestions.name: notrunc
suggestions.description: Do not truncate the output file. This will preserve any blocks in the output file not explicitly written by dd

suggestions.name: osync
suggestions.description: Pad the final output block to the full output block size

suggestions.name: sparse
suggestions.description: If one or more output blocks would consist solely of NUL bytes, try to seek the output file by the required space instead of filling them with NULs, resulting i…

suggestions.name: swab
suggestions.description: Swap every pair of input bytes

suggestions.name: sync
suggestions.description: Pad every input block to the input buffer size

suggestions.name: ucase
suggestions.description: Transform lowercase characters into uppercase characters

suggestions.name: unblock
suggestions.description: Treats the input as a sequence of fixed length records independent of input and output block boundaries
